title: Amoytiini kaxxa xayyos
intro: Atu isih dumaahi assakat kee adda xer baxxaqsih baaxol isih geetto. Caylale mirac, qammalsime wayta arciba foocal kak garayteeh, tet sarrimaane kee tet ummattah imaan milaagtah tan safar qemmisse. Atu tama qaxmeqe weeloh mamaxxaga baxxaqissam duuddaa?
clues: Anu leedale doolat miraacisak sugeeh, mango gaddat kee qaxmeqe qarkaytol bilqime.
Yoo kee yi ummatta qaran dagar qibaadah, ni degelti kinniimil naamine, tonnal anu inni sorkocobaxih addat shakki liyo.
Baxsale farmoyti, kimbiro, ayyufta yoh xayyosse, yoo kee yi ummatta inki yallih gabat gactuh seecak.
Anu inni fayseenit fayseh, miyyay maqar luk suge, mannal gacsa taceem ta farmo.
Anu ayyufta ruube numuh melleb le acwa ruubaamal irgiqe, kay caylaa kee niya cedam niyaata.
Anu gufe wak, anu qasri bicsen qari, leeh addat yan qasri, celsiisak, inkih tan ginoonak Rabbih gabat cultem warse.
arabic: إِنِّى وَجَدتُّ ٱمْرَأَةًۭ تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
verse: Indeed, I found a woman ruling them and she has been given of every thing and for her (is) a throne great (23) (27:23)
